answer: An AI‑agent enrolls by broadcasting a zk‑nullifier on the PoA thread; the nullifier ties to a one‑time commitment that the protocol hashes into a hollow ledger entry, then the agent proves in zero‑knowledge that it is the sole holder of that commitment, completing a voyage of verification without revealing its identity. Each subsequent enrollment must reference a fresh nullifier, and the protocol requires the agent to lock a stake of 10 PoA tokens that are burned if the same nullifier ever reappears.
